note: Evil Mode slice 6: the Line (design Part 3 section 7, Part 5 sections 4 and 6, Part 7 sections 6, 7, 9 and 11, Part 9 section 10, Part 29 section 2.1). Lean, Take and Expose; Heat's ladder; Dread; the three stops; moving the Line; three more ways to leave. Numbers are starting values, not playtested.

things.name: The stock
things.gives: Funds once: {amount}, three days of what the place earns.

things.name: The deed
things.gives: The holding, as a deed. It's paper: the kid can't turn it.
things.written: Took the deed from {to}, and used it.

things.name: The ledger
things.gives: Proof, for an Expose. Or, where there's nothing to prove, what everyone on the street earns.

ladder.doing: A file's been opened. A constable at the Town nods.
Locals are asked about the team. Ones taken by Lean answer.
Somebody with a name is a day behind the team.
Roads are watched: every job but a scout at −20%, unless Wheels leads.
Faces they know can't be sent. A known face on a failed Take is arrested.
They know where the base is.
A Raid. (Not in this build: the lamps just stay lit.)

words.word: The whole district helps the kid

stops.allows: Ask, buy, win, look and publish. Nothing taken that isn't given or won.
stops.darkens: Nothing. Lean and Take aren't on the screen.

stops.allows: Everything Clean hands allows, and Lean, and Take (stock, deeds, ledgers).
stops.darkens: Lean and Take light up. Every Card still says what they cost.

stops.allows: Everything Grey allows. Shadow methods and the Lab come later.
stops.darkens: Every Heart on the Roster leaves within three days, together, at breakfast.

move.once: The Line's already been moved in this region.
move.same: That's where the Line already is.
move.lighter: Lighter. It costs: these people were hired for the old Line.
move.hold: Hold Enter (or press and hold) for two seconds. Letting go early cancels.
move.hearts: {names} won't stay on a team that'll do whatever it takes. They'll go within three days.

leave.lineMoved: left together, by the front, at breakfast. The Line had moved.
leave.lineMovedLight: left. They'd been hired for the old Line.
leave.hero: went with the kid, as far as the next town. They've told the kid everything on their card.
leave.arrested: was arrested. They knew the face from the failed Take.

proof.need: No proof. Take their ledger, or hold a Warm local on their street who was there.
proof.nothing: There's nothing true to publish about them.
proof.witness: A witness: {who}, Warm, on the same street.

lean.takes: {amount} a day, and half as much again, because they're frightened.
lean.takesNothing: Their say on the street, because they're frightened.
lean.gives: {amount} a day from tomorrow. It turns the day the kid arrives.
lean.holds: Turns. The day the kid arrives.
lean.other: Persuade them at {odds}%. Or Pay the fair price: {fair}. It holds.

take.other: Pay the fair price: {fair}. Or Persuade them at {odds}%.

expose.gives: {street} one warmer: the fear they were's lifted.

written.leanFail: They tried to frighten {to}. They were told to get out.
written.comeOver: Step {step} came over on its own. Nobody was in.

wont.title: What this team, as it stands, won't do.
wont.method: This team doesn't {verb}. Whatever the Line says.
wont.noHeart: There's nobody here now who'd stop.
